summary: SUB-01 proxy: replace CORS wildcard with an origin allowlist and optional bearer token

delivery.outcome: subllm proxy no longer answers Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *. Browser requests from origins other than loopback pages and SUBLLM_PROXY_ALLOWED_ORIGINS get 403 PROXY-ORIGIN (preflight and simple requests) before any provider or upstream attempt; allowed origins are echoed with Vary: Origin; requests without Origin (CLI, agents) are unchanged. With SUBLLM_PROXY_TOKEN set, routed (potentially cloud) completions require Authorization: Bearer <token> (401 PROXY-AUTH) while the direct local Ollama forward stays open.
nonGoals: README and docs/operations.md updates are a separate ticket (owned by other workstreams).
No change to the Host check or bind address.

architecture.decision: Origin policy in proxy_origin_allowed (loopback + explicit allowlist; deviation from the plan's empty default so local web UIs such as willmux keep working), enforced in do_GET/do_POST/do_OPTIONS; route token checked at _execute_model_or_route and mapped to 401 by _handle_contract_error so it never falls through to the raw upstream.
interfaceChanges: SUBLLM_PROXY_ALLOWED_ORIGINS and SUBLLM_PROXY_TOKEN environment variables; 403 PROXY-ORIGIN and 401 PROXY-AUTH responses
